description: Recover the generator input from a page es-plus produced. Pages carry their own provenance (`__esPlusSource` inside pageSchema, or a `// __esPlusSource:` comment in sfc mode), so this unzips the recorded input instead of re-inferring a config from the rendered output. It is NOT a claim that artifact and input are identical: every place they differ (dropped unknown keys, keys the mode ignores, non-JSON values, deterministic repairs) is listed in `lossy[]`. Pass the full source of `schema.ts` / `Page.vue` / a bare pageSchema JSON. Returns `config` (exactly what the generator was given, after normalization), `lossy[]`, and `intent` (a mechanical `surfaces` projection you can pass straight to `generate_scene` scene='crud', plus `surfacesLossy[]` for anything the projection itself cannot express, e.g. explicit `columns`). Edit the returned config for the next round, then regenerate. Pages generated before this feature (or hand-written ones) have no provenance: this tool errors with a hint instead of guessing. Composition pages (`generate_composition`) carry a different contract (`// __esPlusCompositionSource:`): for those this returns `kind:'composition'` and the full `plan` to replay verbatim — it does NOT project them to `surfaces`, because role/wire details would be lost.

code.description: Full source text of the generated page: schema.ts, Page.vue (sfc mode), or a bare pageSchema JSON.

label.description: Name used in error messages (e.g. the file name). Defaults to "page".

name: read_page
